title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I don’t think my assigned press box seat is going to be in the third row, directly to your right
I think it’s going to be your own suite. Every media member will likely get one if they get sign off
No, I mean if the Tigers sign off on the idea, then that’s the plan. I don’t know if it’s going to happen but it’s the goal
Gonna put pictures up in my suite
I’ll take some of myself for your Suite
